name: Smart Search's advanced form follows the dashboard theme through the kit's tokens: as viewer, a link holding a tree (a None-of group) in Dark, Light, Apple TV and Purple Haze (localStorage '<userId>-appTheme', a reload, then the link): the page's text is the theme's text colour, a nested group's edge and the pressed Advanced are the theme's accent, and a rule's error is coloured as the form's own errors. Screenshots smartsearch-advanced-theme-*.png.

steps.name: page helpers
the colours (Dark)
steps.eval: (() => { const host = document.querySelector('[data-jfss-page="search"][data-jfss-mounted]'); const err = __ss.all('.jfss-node-error').find(n => n.textContent); return { pageColor: getComputedStyle(host).color, htmlColor: getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).color, groupEdge: getComputedStyle(__ss.all('.jfss-group')[1]).borderInlineStartColor, modeBackground: getComputedStyle(__ss.q('.jfss-mode[aria-pressed="true"]')).backgroundColor, error: err ? getComputedStyle(err).color : '', formError: getComputedStyle(__ss.q('.jfss-form-error')).color }; })()
